priorityReason: The signed-in profile route can stall and the Owner requires username, passkey, TOTP and recovery methods on the productive account surface.
scopeBoundary: Browser remains tokenless; Supabase access and refresh tokens stay in backend HttpOnly cookies.
SMS verification and recovery fail closed until CAPITAL_AI_PHONE_AUTH_ENABLED=true after provider, abuse and cost approval.
HIBP remains exclusively ADR-0031 PLAN-CONSTRAINED; this slice does not activate or relabel it.
No direct main, Production, Render or protected Supabase schema/config mutation.
Versioned migration applies only through the canonical post-merge migration workflow.

evidence.openWriterOverlap: PASS: PR #1392 was the sole open writer at CURRENT_MAIN d1d083437f8b correlation; no changed-file overlap with merged PR #1393.

acceptanceCriteria: Password login accepts normalized e-mail or username through the backend boundary.
Passkey and password primary login require verified TOTP when an AAL2 factor is enrolled.
OAuth callback self-heals a missing profile and leaves MFA-pending sessions unusable until verification.
Profile and Einstellungen tabs use the website brand and session bootstrap cannot hang indefinitely.
Profile stores avatar plus bounded fintech preferences and selections.
Phone verification/recovery is implemented but explicitly provider-gated.
Versioned migration and focused regression evidence pass.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no direct-main mutation.
